__comment_purpose: Read by build_hess_vti2d_case.py to generate model.mat, source.mat, BC.mat, source/receiver geometry, and run scripts. Rebuild the case after editing this file; existing cases are not updated automatically.
__comment_case_directory: Relative paths are resolved against this configuration directory. Absolute paths are also accepted.

hess_model.__comment_model_directory: Directory containing input files such as Hess_rho.mat and Hess_C11.mat. Update this machine-specific path before building. Use forward slashes in Windows JSON paths to avoid backslash escape sequences.
hess_model.__comment_parameterization: stiffness reads rho, C11, C13, C33, and C44 directly. thomsen reads rho, vp, epsilon, and delta, plus C44 or vs selected by thomsen_shear, then converts to stiffness. The current setting is stiffness.
hess_model.__comment_storage_dtype: Precision of the generated material arrays. float64 uses twice the array storage of float32; this setting is separate from forward.dtype.
hess_model.__comment_orientation: Final arrays must use [z,x] order. transpose swaps the axes; flip_x reverses x; flip_z reverses z. Operations run in this order: transpose, flip_z, flip_x, crop, then stride.

crop.__comment_crop: Python half-open ranges [x_start,x_end) and [z_start,z_end). A null end includes the rest of that axis. The current settings retain the full model.

stride.__comment_stride: Spatial decimation, not time sampling: 1 keeps every cell; 2 keeps every other cell. The builder multiplies dx and dz by the corresponding strides. Apply spatial low-pass filtering before strong decimation.

scales.__comment_unit_scales: Input arrays are multiplied by these factors. density and stiffness apply in both parameterizations; velocity applies only in thomsen mode. SI inputs normally use 1.0; use velocity=0.3048 for ft/s to m/s.

hess_model.__comment_thomsen_shear: Used only when parameterization=thomsen. C44 reads shear stiffness directly; vs reads shear velocity and computes C44=rho*vs^2. Ignored in stiffness mode.

files.__comment_file_mapping: filename identifies the MAT file; variable identifies its internal array. stiffness mode reads only rho, C11, C13, C33, C44, and optional C66. Other mappings are unused in that mode.
files.__comment_C66: null makes the builder use C66=C44. C66 is retained for VTI file compatibility and material validation, but does not enter 2-D x-z qP-qSV propagation. Supply the actual C66 for 3-D or SH modelling.

grid.__comment_grid_spacing: Input spacing dx/dz in metres before spatial decimation. The current 5.0 values assume 5 m input sampling; original, unresampled 20 ft Hess data would require 6.096 m.

__comment_mat_compression: false avoids MAT compression and generally reduces save/load work at the cost of larger files. true compresses MAT arrays.

pml.__comment_pml_thickness: Split-PML thickness in grid cells on the left, right, top, and bottom boundaries. Require 2*nAB < min(nx,nz) after model transformations.
pml.__comment_reflection_coefficient: Target reflection coefficient used to design PML damping, not a strict guarantee of measured reflection amplitude. Must be in (0,1).
pml.__comment_polynomial_power: Power of the damping profile measured into PML from its inner edge; 2.0 gives a quadratic profile.
pml.__comment_boundary_type: topABC applies absorption at the top as well as the other boundaries. It is the only boundary type supported by this 2-D solver.

source.__comment_source_position: Zero-based grid indices in [x,z] order, not physical distances in metres. Place the source inside the active stencil region for forward.order.
source.__comment_source_kind: explosive injects a normal-stress source; dc_xz injects a double-couple source in the x-z plane.
source.__comment_time_sampling: total_time and dt are in seconds. The builder creates floor(total_time/dt+0.5)+1 samples. dt must also satisfy the conservative CFL check.
source.__comment_ricker_wavelet: f0 is the Ricker central frequency in hertz; t0 is the wavelet centre delay from t=0 in seconds.
source.__comment_source_scale: Dimensionless wavelet amplitude multiplier. Wavefields and receiver responses scale proportionally in this linear propagation scheme, up to numerical roundoff.

receivers.__comment_receiver_line: line creates a horizontal line at fixed z; x_stop is inclusive. All coordinates are zero-based grid indices. Current settings define one receiver at [30,1]. With forward.order=6, z=1 is in the inactive stencil halo; choose an active receiver position when recording propagated waves.

plot.__comment_model_plot: Controls the model figure generated while building the case. cmap is used for density, velocity, and stiffness; anisotropy_cmap is used for epsilon/delta. Figure width/height are in inches and dpi sets output resolution.

forward.__comment_python_executable: Interpreter path written into run_gpu.ps1 and run_cpu.ps1. Update it for your environment. Direct main.py commands use the interpreter chosen on the command line.
forward.__comment_spatial_order: Staggered-grid spatial finite-difference order: 2, 4, 6, 8, or 10. Higher orders use a wider stencil and more arithmetic. The outer order/2 cells are excluded from propagation.
forward.__comment_compute_dtype: Precision of the propagated fields and Triton operations: fp32 or fp64. fp64 uses twice the field storage; its speed depends on the GPU.
forward.__comment_triton_block: Number of elements processed by each Triton program instance; affects GPU execution, not model parameters. Supported values: 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024.
forward.__comment_record_stride: Save receivers every record_stride simulation steps. The output sampling interval is dt*record_stride. Must be positive.
forward.__comment_snapshot_step: -1 selects the last active step, N-3. Otherwise choose an integer step in [1,N-3]. The stored snapshot time follows (snapshot_step-1)*dt.
forward.__comment_forward_output: The generated launchers place this relative output directory inside the generated case directory.
forward.__comment_output_prefix: Filename prefix for forward MAT/NPZ results, JSON metadata, and figures.
